build_system: Angular CLI — ng build. No npm workspaces. package.json at project root.
test_framework: None configured (no spec files for the affected components). Manual UI testing is the verification method.
verification_instructions: 1. Run ng build --configuration=production. Expect 0 errors. 2. If a dev server is running, changes are hot-reloaded. 3. Manual runtime test: log in as a user with createAccess=true/updateAccess=false for a page — confirm Update button hidden in edit mode. Log in with updateAccess=true/createAccess=false — confirm Save button hidden in new mode.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Project root: c:\Users\admin\Documents\India FWG\OBMSINDIA-UI. All edits must be inside src\app\modules\. Never restart a dev server.
contribution_requirements: Only modify *ngIf expressions on Save/Update/Restore/Process buttons. Do not change component logic (.ts files) unless a FEAT explicitly requires it. Do not add/remove HTML structure.
key_patterns: 1. All files use this.userAccessModel.createAccess and this.userAccessModel.updateAccess (prefixed with 'this.'). 2. currentUser is a component property holding the username string. 3. 'superadmin' and 'admin' always bypass access checks. 4. The broken pattern is: createAccess == true || updateAccess == true || currentUser == 'superadmin'. 5. Mode-detection varies per file: form ID field (== 0 new / != 0 edit), isEdit boolean, isEditMode boolean, dedicated ID property (receiptID, paymentID, invoiceID, attendanceID, advanceID), or title string ('new'/'edit').
directory_structure: src/app/modules/ contains: Accounting/, administration/, dashboard/, finance/, inventory/, master/, payroll/, quotation-and-agreement/, report/, user/. Each sub-module has list components (*.component.html) and form components (new-*.component.html). The plan.md at .agents/tasks/plan.md has the full per-file details.
